description: This file defines exception handling logic for a FastAPI web application, including custom handlers for different exception types used within the openbb platform.

classes.name: ExceptionHandlers
classes.description: A collection of static methods to handle various exceptions and errors within the FastAPI application.

methods.name: _handle(exception: Exception, status_code: int, detail: Any)
methods.description: Private static method that logs the exception and returns a JSONResponse with the specified status code and detail.

methods.name: JSONResponse exception(_: Request, error: Exception)
methods.description: Handles general exceptions, differentiating between value errors, missing parameters, and other errors. Returns JSON responses accordingly.

methods.name: validation( request: Request, error: Union[ValidationError, ResponseValidationError] )
methods.description: Handles validation errors from Pydantic models or ResponseValidationError, mapping them into JSON responses for client-side error reporting.

methods.name: openbb(_: Request, error: OpenBBError)
methods.description: Handles OpenBBError exceptions, returning a JSON response with the error's original message.

methods.name: empty_data(_: Request, error: EmptyDataError)
methods.description: Handles EmptyDataError exceptions, returning a 204 No Content response.

methods.name: unauthorized(_: Request, error: UnauthorizedError)
methods.description: Handles UnauthorizedError exceptions, returning a 502 Bad Gateway response with details.

ctags.name: _handle
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _handle(exception: Exception, status_code: int, detail: Any):$/

ctags.name: empty_data
ctags.pattern: /^    async def empty_data(_: Request, error: EmptyDataError):$/

ctags.name: exception
ctags.pattern: /^    async def exception(_: Request, error: Exception) -> JSONResponse:$/

ctags.name: openbb
ctags.pattern: /^    async def openbb(_: Request, error: OpenBBError):$/

ctags.name: unauthorized
ctags.pattern: /^    async def unauthorized(_: Request, error: UnauthorizedError):$/
